summary.key_theme: 市場對 Amazon 在 AI 晶片與雲端領域的長期成長潛力持樂觀態度，但同時面臨監管壓力、勞工組織化挑戰以及電商成長放緩的隱憂。

bullish.title: Amazon Stocks Edge Higher as Custom-Chip Commitments Increase More Than 20-Fold
bullish.reason: 自研晶片需求激增 20 倍，顯示 AWS 在 AI 基礎設施領域的競爭力顯著提升，為長期獲利提供強勁支撐。

bullish.title: Amazon Has 40% Upside, Joseph Carlson Says: 'One of the Best Opportunities'
bullish.reason: 知名投資人看好 Amazon 具備 40% 的上漲空間，強調其在雲端與電商領域的雙重護城河。

bullish.title: Why Amazon Stock Can Keep Rising Through 2035
bullish.reason: 分析指出電商利潤率改善是長期被低估的機會，結合雲端業務將推動未來十年的成長。

bullish.title: 2 Monster Stocks to Buy and Hold for the Next 20 Years
bullish.reason: 將 Amazon 列為 AI 支出浪潮下的長期贏家，認為短期股價回調提供了買入機會。

bullish.title: Amazon (AMZN) Sees $185.8 Million in Net ETF Buying on Friday
bullish.reason: ETF 淨買入 1.858 億美元，顯示機構投資人對該股的資金流向保持正面。

bullish.title: Brad Gerstner Says Anthropic Is “Stomping on the Gas.” Amazon and Google Sell the Fuel
bullish.reason: Amazon 作為 Anthropic 的關鍵投資者與基礎設施提供商，將持續受惠於 AI 新創的快速擴張。

bullish.title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Could Be Entering Its Next Growth Phase: Here’s What Investors Should Know
bullish.reason: 引用 Pershing Square 投資信件，暗示公司正進入新的成長階段。

bullish.title: Amazon brings its own low-priced Thanksgiving meal deal to the table
bullish.reason: 透過低價節慶餐點促銷，有助於提升零售業務的市占率與客戶黏著度。

bearish.title: Amazon's Earnings Just Hit a Record. So Why Is the Stock Down 11% From Its Peak?
bearish.reason: 儘管獲利創新高，但市場擔憂現金流與電商成長放緩，導致股價自高點回調 11%。

bearish.title: Update: Apple, Amazon Face Sanction Proceedings From Spanish Regulator
bearish.reason: 面臨西班牙監管機構的制裁程序，可能帶來法律風險與潛在罰款。

bearish.title: Amazon cuts more jobs as CEO touts record margins, retail gains
bearish.reason: 持續裁員反映出公司在追求利潤率的同時，內部營運結構仍存在調整壓力。

bearish.title: Unifor to launch new organizing initiative with Amazon workers in the Greater Toronto Area
bearish.reason: 工會組織活動擴大，可能增加未來的人力成本與勞資糾紛風險。

bearish.title: Amazon, Google and Microsoft Are 'Absolute Jokes' Compared With SpaceX, Says Sequoia's Shaun Maguire
bearish.reason: 知名創投合夥人對科技巨頭的創新能力提出質疑，可能影響市場對其成長動能的信心。

bearish.title: Amazon Is Sending Prime Refunds of Up to $200. Here’s Why You Might Not Qualify
bearish.reason: 退款事件可能引發消費者對服務條款的負面觀感與爭議。

neutral.title: Tesla, Amazon, and SpaceX among companies snubbing tokenized stocks
neutral.reason: 公司拒絕參與代幣化股票交易，屬於正常的企業法律與合規決策，對股價無實質影響。

neutral.title: Shopify vs. Amazon: Which Stock Wins When AI Agents Do the Shopping?
neutral.reason: 探討 AI 代理對電商競爭格局的影響，屬於產業趨勢分析，未對 Amazon 產生直接利多或利空。

neutral.title: Ricardo Domínguez's Entre Cajas Academy is Building KILTA for Amazon Sellers
neutral.reason: 第三方教育機構為 Amazon 賣家開發工具，對公司本身影響有限。

neutral.title: Amazon-Backed Anthropic Plans Retail Share Offerings in Six International Markets
neutral.reason: 被投企業 Anthropic 的業務擴張，對 Amazon 財務影響間接且中性。

neutral.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
neutral.reason: 與第一篇新聞重複，確認 Amazon 反對代幣化交易，屬於合規性聲明。

neutral.title: Ex-amazon VP Ethan Evans on why Bezos read complaints himself
neutral.reason: 回顧前高管對 Bezos 管理風格的評論，屬於歷史經驗分享，無市場影響力。
